description: The hosts a library release is expected to reach, so a harden-runner report is read against a list instead of from memory. Documentation only: nothing reads this file in CI, and a host that is not listed is a question to answer, not a failure. Written from the harden-runner report of a library's 1.4.14 release. A host with a star is a family: the numbered or hashed part varies from run to run.

publish.description: The credentialed job: nothing from the package runs while the token exists.

build.description: The publish families without the two signing hosts, plus the following.
build.perRepository: The link hosts of the repository's README, reached by the published-surface link check (check:published); they differ per repository and are not listed here.

notes.prod.app-api.stepsecurity.io: The harden-runner agent's own API, resolved when the agent starts, so it appears in every job that runs it.
notes.agent.api.stepsecurity.io: Tried by the agent before the host above; a build that cannot reach it can time out at the first step.
